items.t: VVT oil line bursts and dumps engine oil
items.job: Replace rubber-hose VVT oil line with all-metal line and refill oil
items.note: Toyota's ZE2 program covered this line; ask a dealer with your VIN. Engine damage from running without oil costs far more.

items.t: Water pump leak on the V6
items.job: Replace water pump, thermostat and drive belt (V6)
items.note: Shops often quote over $1,000 on the V6 because of access.

items.t: Water pump leak on the 4-cylinder
items.job: Replace water pump (4-cylinder)

items.t: Brief rattle on cold start
items.job: Replace camshaft timing (VVT) gear with updated part
items.note: Samarins puts this at about $380–$590 out of warranty.

items.t: Valve cover gasket oil leak
items.job: Replace valve cover gasket(s) and spark plug tube seals
items.note: The V6 rear cover takes longest. Replace oil-soaked spark plugs at the same time.

items.t: Oil consumption at higher mileage
items.job: Oil consumption test, then piston ring and valve seal repair if needed
items.note: Most owners simply monitor and top up the oil. A used engine can cost less than a ring job.

items.t: Hesitation or jerky shifts when accelerating
items.job: Transmission diagnosis, software check and fluid exchange
items.note: If the transmission is damaged inside, a rebuild or replacement costs much more.

items.t: Warped front brake rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Rattle from the steering column
items.job: Replace steering column assembly
items.note: Samarins notes the column part alone is over $1,000.

items.t: Panoramic glass roof shatters
items.job: Replace panoramic roof glass
items.note: Owner-reported repair bills average about $1,700–$1,800. Glass insurance coverage may apply.

items.t: Humming wheel bearing
items.job: Replace one wheel bearing/hub assembly
items.note: Samarins puts this at about $270–$420 per wheel.

items.t: Worn front struts
items.job: Replace both front struts and align
items.note: Samarins puts this at about $680–$820 for the pair.

items.t: Check engine light from a failed air-fuel sensor
items.job: Replace air-fuel ratio or oxygen sensor

items.t: ABS light from a wheel speed sensor
items.job: Replace one ABS wheel speed sensor

items.t: Tire pressure light from corroded sensors
items.job: Replace tire pressure sensor(s) and relearn
items.note: Price range covers one to four sensors.

items.t: No-start from corroded battery terminals
items.job: Clean or replace battery terminals and test battery
items.note: A new battery adds about $150–$250 if it fails testing.

items.t: Factory alarm goes off by itself
items.job: Replace hood latch assembly with revised part
items.note: RepairPal lists hood latch replacement at about $245–$312.

items.t: Check engine light from the gas cap or EVAP system
items.job: Replace gas cap
items.note: If a new cap does not fix it, an EVAP smoke test is the next step.

items.t: Accelerator pedal can be trapped by the floor mat (recall)
items.job: Recall 10V-023: pedal and floor mat remedy

items.t: Brake lights may not work (recall)
items.job: Recall 12V-091: replace brake light switch

items.t: Seat heater wiring can short and burn (recall)
items.job: Recall 14V-743: seat heater repair

items.t: A/C drain leak can wet the airbag computer (recall)
items.job: Recall 13V-442: A/C drain and airbag module protection

items.t: Driver door wiring can disable side airbags (recall)
items.job: Recall 21V-257: repair driver door airbag wiring

items.t: Passenger airbag sensor not recalibrated after accessories (recall)
items.job: Recall 13V-014: recalibrate passenger occupant sensor

items.t: Windshield cracks from small stone chips
items.job: Replace windshield and recalibrate front camera
items.note: Owners report bills of about $1,000–$2,000. Chip repair early costs far less.

items.t: 12-volt battery drains while parked
items.job: Test or replace 12V battery and apply DCM software update
items.note: The software update should be free under warranty; the battery may not need replacing.

items.t: Shadows from low-beam headlights
items.job: Check and adjust headlight aim
items.note: There is no known parts fix.

items.t: Milky oil and low oil pressure warning in cold weather
items.job: Oil and filter change per Toyota bulletin
items.note: Should be covered under warranty when the bulletin applies.

items.t: Check engine light from an EVAP valve or tank pressure sensor
items.job: Replace EVAP switching valve or fuel tank pressure sensor
items.note: Often covered by the emissions warranty.

items.t: Musty smell or wet floor from a blocked A/C drain
items.job: Clear A/C drain, clean evaporator and replace cabin filter
items.note: Drying soaked carpet adds time.

items.t: Damaged cover on the rear motor wiring connector
items.job: Replace rear motor connector cover

items.t: Rear turn signals can short from moisture (recall)
items.job: Recall 22V-033: replace rear turn signal lamps

items.t: Stability control may stay off after restart (recall)
items.job: Recall 22V-239: skid control computer software update

items.t: Instrument panel may not show speed or warning lights (recall)
items.job: Recall 25V-595: instrument panel software update

items.t: Backup camera may freeze or go blank (recall)
items.job: Recall 25V-744: camera software update
